guidance.statement: FY27 Aluminium production guided at 2.6 - 2.7 Mnt
Vision of achieving 3 million tonnes of annual zinc production across India and South Africa.
Vedanta Zinc International business aims to contribute 1 million tonnes of zinc annually.

operating_notes.text: Turnover of BALCO for FY25 was ₹15,909 Cr (about 10% of consolidated turnover) and net worth was ₹12,088 Cr (39% of consolidated net worth).
Hindustan Zinc reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹13,544 Cr and PAT of ₹5,033 Cr, and declared an interim dividend of ₹4,648 Cr.
Record annual Alumina production at Lanjigarh refinery of 2,916 kt, up 48% YoY.
Lowest Aluminium COP in 5 years at $1,752/t in FY26.
Zinc India achieved its lowest-ever quarterly cost of production (excluding royalty) of $903/MT in Q4FY26.
Board approved revision of Dividend Distribution Policy effective from FY 2027 to balance shareholder returns with growth and deleveraging.
Promoter entities upsized a facility agreement from US$ 350,000,000 to US$ 600,000,000 for debt repayment and general corporate purposes.
Promoter Vedanta Resources Limited upsized a facility agreement from USD 350,000,000 to USD 600,000,000, creating a negative lien on 56.38% of Vedanta Limited's equity.
Cost of acquisition apportionment set at 52.34% for Vedanta Ltd, 21.49% for Malco Energy, 12.23% for Talwandi Sabo Power, 7.15% for Vedanta Aluminium, and 6.79% for Vedanta Iron and Steel.
Supreme Court upheld a ₹127 Cr penalty plus surcharges against subsidiary TSPL for 2017 grid code violations.
ICRA upgraded long-term ratings for Vedanta Limited (AA+), Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited (AA+), and Talwandi Sabo Power Limited (AA-), all with Stable outlooks.
CRISIL reaffirmed ratings for NCDs and long-term facilities at AA+/Stable and short-term facilities at A1+.
Doubled South Africa zinc capacity to 500,000 tonnes per annum via $600 Mn Gamsberg Phase II investment.
Hindustan Zinc Q2FY27 revenue at ₹14,582 Cr and net profit at ₹6,412 Cr.

timeline.summary: Vedanta fixes May 1, 2026 record date for 4-way demerger and approves BALCO stake transfer to VAML.
Subsidiary Hindustan Zinc declared a ₹4,648 Cr interim dividend and reported FY26 net profit of ₹13,832 Cr.
Vedanta reported record Q4FY26 PAT of ₹9,352 Cr and EBITDA of ₹18,447 Cr, with net debt/EBITDA improving to 0.95x ahead of its May 1 demerger.
Vedanta revised its dividend policy for FY27 and appointed M/s M S K A & Associates LLP as statutory auditors.
CRISIL assigned 'AA' rating to NCDs and withdrew rating on ₹6,089 Cr of debt ahead of its transfer to Vedanta Aluminium Metal Ltd.
ICRA assigned 'ICRA AA' to NCDs, reaffirmed ICRA AA/Watch Developing and ICRA A1+, and withdrew rating on ₹2,600 Cr NCDs being transferred to Vedanta Aluminium Metal Ltd.
Vedanta Limited’s shareholders approved Mr. S.V. Murali Dhar Rao’s appointment as Non-Special Executive Independent Director via remote e-voting on May 07, 2026.
Vedanta Limited announced the cost of acquisition apportionment for its four-way demerger effective May 01, 2026.
The Supreme Court upheld a ₹127 Cr penalty against Vedanta subsidiary Talwandi Sabo Power for misdeclaration of power availability in 2017.
ICRA upgraded Vedanta Limited's long-term credit rating to AA+ with a Stable outlook on May 27, 2026.
Ankit Agarwal confirmed no encumbrance on Vedanta Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26.
Vedanta Limited disclosed that an Enforcement Directorate team visited some offices of the company and subsidiary Hindustan Zinc Limited.
Vedanta Power Limited (formerly Talwandi Sabo Power Limited) changed its name to Vedanta Power Limited, effective June 03, 2026, per MCA approval.
CRISIL reaffirmed Vedanta Limited's long-term credit rating at AA+/Stable and short-term rating at A1+ on October 16, 2026.
Vedanta commissioned the Gamsberg Phase II expansion in South Africa, doubling its zinc production capacity there to 500,000 tonnes per annum.
Vedanta Limited informed the exchange about the Q2FY27 financial results of its subsidiary Hindustan Zinc Limited.
